rzv-px4-dualcr8.name: RZ/V2H PX4 Dual-Core (dualcr8 + io-cr8_1_pwm)
rzv-px4-dualcr8.description: Full PX4 sensor & flight core on CR8-0 (dualcr8) paired with PWM actuator supervisor on CR8-1 (io-cr8_1_pwm).

rzv-native-ipc-rtt.name: RZ/V2H Native Dual-CR8 IPC (RTT Console)
rzv-native-ipc-rtt.description: Native raw IPC pair on RZ/V2H CR8-0 and CR8-1 with RTT consoles on both cores.

rzv-native-ipc-sci4.name: RZ/V2H Native Dual-CR8 IPC (SCI4 Serial / RTT)
rzv-native-ipc-sci4.description: Native raw IPC pair on RZ/V2H with CR8-0 on SCI4 serial and CR8-1 on RTT.

rzv-native-ipc-demo-sci4.name: RZ/V2H IPC Showcase Demo (SCI4 Serial / RTT)
rzv-native-ipc-demo-sci4.description: Customer IPC showcase (ipcdemo): ping, messages and a 5 s heartbeat between CR8-0 on SCI4 serial and CR8-1 on RTT, with automatic link recovery.

ra8p1-dual-ipc.name: RA8P1 Dual-Core IPC (CM85 + CM33)
ra8p1-dual-ipc.description: Dual-core IPC pair on RA8P1 (CM85 Core 0 + CM33 Core 1). Build supported; target load gated.

ra8p1-dual-mini.name: RA8P1 Dual-Core Mini Startup (mini-CM85 + nsh-CM33)
ra8p1-dual-mini.description: Mini CM85 startup + CM33 NSH pair on RA8P1. Build supported; target load gated.
